subject.statement: Warren Buffett is currently the CEO of Berkshire Hathaway.

summary: Warren Buffett has served as Chairman and CEO of Berkshire Hathaway for decades and, as of the latest public information up to 2025, he remained in the CEO role with no announced succession. No credible reports indicate he stepped down before 2026-10-01.
